identification: Carton of mostly modern Tasmanian-interest paperbacks (Trout Fishing Guide to Tasmania by Don Gilmour, Fauna of Tasmania Birds by R H Green x2, Only in Tasmania 2, Manganinnie, Glamorgan history, Rocks of Anglesey's Coast, Phillip Island and Western Port, Fatal Storm by Rob Mundle (1998 Sydney-Hobart), The Story of Port Dalrymple by Bethell, One Man's Journey, The French Presence in Australia, The Shape of Water, Blades Down Under 1990 World Rowing Champs), plus Tall Ships Australia 1998 official programme and a bundle of old legal papers incl. a Conveyance with red wax seal (the 1860s/1880s deeds). Little sailing content seen. Deeds are the only possible interest, content unreadable.
